candidate_title: Exact Hausdorff dimension of Liouville quantum gravity
exact_statement: For gamma in (0,2), compute d_gamma, the a.s. Hausdorff dimension of the plane equipped with the gamma-LQG metric D_h; d_gamma is defined in the paper through xi_gamma=gamma/d_gamma.
original_primary_source: Gwynne and Miller, Existence and uniqueness of the Liouville quantum gravity metric for gamma in (0,2), Inventiones Mathematicae 2020, Problem 7.1, https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00222-020-00991-6

result_rows.statement: Problem 7.1 asks for d_gamma for all gamma in (0,2); gamma=sqrt(8/3) has known d_gamma=4 and therefore cannot be counted as a solution of the general problem.
